title: World Map

bundledDerivatives.conversionCommand: pnpm dlx sharp-cli@5.2.0 -i world-map.webp -o world-map-2048.webp -f webp -q 90 --effort 6 resize 2048 2048 --fit fill --kernel lanczos3
pnpm dlx sharp-cli@5.2.0 -i world-map.webp -o world-map-4096.webp -f webp -q 90 --effort 6 resize 4096 4096 --fit fill --kernel lanczos3
